svg.title: How to judge a new fixture
svg.desc: Question the pressure: What do another match and another sponsor cost players?. Consider access: Income can repair facilities and welcome new members.. Give the club a test: Compare injuries, uses of the ground and income after the change.

g.text: How to judge a new fixture
What do another match and another sponsor cost players?
Income can repair facilities and welcome new members.
Compare injuries, uses of the ground and income after the change.
